lines.say: Welcome to Claude Mastery, from Lets Vibe A.I.
lines.cap: Welcome to Claude Mastery, from LetsVibeAI.

lines: Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
In this first lesson, you'll pick a harness, and get it running in about ten minutes.

items.t: Let the agent run the camera

scenes.headline: A harness is the app around the model.
lines: A model is the brain. A harness is everything around it.
It reads your files, runs commands, calls tools, and remembers your rules.
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code are all harnesses.

scenes.headline: Five layers. Every time.
lines: Under the hood, every harness has the same five layers.
The model.
Context, which is your rules and memory.
Capabilities, like skills and tool connections.
Surfaces, meaning chat, terminal or editor.
And orchestration, where agents work together.

scenes.headline: Start with the one you already use.
lines: Start with whatever you already use.
If you like the terminal, try Claude Code, Codex, or Hermes.
If you live in an editor, try VS Code, Cursor, or Antigravity.
Everything in this course carries over to all of them.

banner.t: Skills you learn here transfer to every harness

scenes.headline: Give it a folder and git.
lines: Make a fresh folder, and turn it into a git repo.
Git is your undo button. Every change the agent makes can be reviewed, and rolled back.
Then launch the harness inside that folder.

callout.t: Every change is reviewable and reversible.
callout.label: Git = undo

scenes.headline: Three prompts for day one.
lines: Here are three prompts to try on day one.
First, ask it to explain the folder.
Then ask for a plan, and tell it not to write code yet.
Finally, ask it to do just step one, then stop.

steps.p: Do step one, then stop and show me.

scenes.headline: What you just learned.
lines: Quick recap.
A harness is the app around the model, and every harness shares the same five layers.
Your mission: install one harness, start a git repo, and run the three day-one prompts.
